text:
Hey everyone :wave:

We’re making it super simple to analyze sensitive data safely and instantly — no heavy setup needed.

:bulb: What we’re offering
As part of our MVP testing, we’re running a free pre-pilot where we:
• Look at your historical communication data (from the last 6–12 months)
• Review key business events from that time
• Map them against employee communication patterns to spot trends and insights that can guide future decisions

It’s completely free — you get valuable insights, and we learn how to make the product better.

:file_folder: What you need: 
• A JSON file from Slack or MS Teams
• A CSV export from your HR system

We’ve made it super easy — there’s an open-source GitHub repo with all the steps to anonymize your data automatically. You can double-check that nothing confidential is included before sharing. Once it’s ready, just upload the anonymized CSV to Google Drive or Dropbox and share the link with us.

:handshake: How we’ll work together
You’ll be able to:
• Ask specific questions you want us to explore in the data
• Collaborate with us as we shape the product

That way, we’re building something genuinely useful — together :rocket:

If you know someone who’d be curious about how employees communicate and behave during key business events, feel free to share this with them too!
